text: The TTC and Metrolinx have successfully advanced PRESTO related issues through the TTC-Metrolinx Joint Advisory Group (JAG) Committee. As we work together to open and operate Lines 5 and 6, advance transit expansion projects, continue with the One Fare program, further coordinate service, and modernize fare collection it is critical that there is continued collaboration and coordinated oversight between the two organizations.

The TTC Board requested that TTC staff work with Metrolinx staff to establish a formal advisory committee that includes representation of Board Members from both organizations, with the goal of enhancing coordination, fostering strategic alignment, and ensuring effective governance of shared transit priorities.
